message.content:
{
  "prompt": "In the context of two threads updating a shared sum, what synchronization mechanism is used to protect the critical section, and what does it protect?",
  "source": "S2",
  "options": [],
  "answer": "Mutex",
  "accepted_answers": ["Mutex", "pthread_mutex", "lock", "mutex lock"],
  "hint": "Consider the mechanism that ensures only one thread executes the critical section at a time.",
  "explanation": "A mutex serializes access to the critical section, preventing race conditions on the shared sum."
}
